reasoning: C.H. Brewitt-Taylor published the first complete English translation in 1925 (Kelly & Walsh, Shanghai), confirmed unabridged on Archive.org and held by hundreds of libraries (WorldCat OCLC 4870736, HathiTrust). Moss Roberts produced a second complete translation in 1991 (UC Press/FLP 1994). This is one of the most translated Chinese classics; no first-translation claim holds.
